all_nine_grammar_rows.rule: Literal whole forms and typed constructions only. Inherited action names are not occurrence counts: C1 has two action names, C3 one habitual unweaving assertion, C5 one habitual weaving assertion, C8 one bounded weaving assertion. No character, suffix or segment meaning is inferred.

ACTION contrast ACTION OBJECT constructs an ordered pair of action types sharing its following object. It does not execute either action. STATE SOCIAL_ACT constructs a prospective prerequisite proposition. These two constructions are nominal/propositional contexts; bare action clauses elsewhere assert the written action.

There is one persistent cloth C. Its first literal qokedy introduces C; later qokedy refers to C. Inherited weave/unravel/finish predicates have C as patient by their unchanged meanings. A written worker noun binds the worker; subsequent omitted worker arguments use the most recent compatible worker. W first appears in C3, before every actor-requiring asserted clause. C2 is initially an open proposition and receives W when PLEDGE binds it; no forward invisible person or action is inserted.

Modifiers precede their action head, except a postposed actor and an action-final completive. TIME preceding a speech predicate attaches to that speech act. UNTIL STATE ACTION marks a prospective endpoint and does not assert its achievement. ACTION ROW ROW uses the explicitly hypothetical distributive noun repetition construction. It has no number, duration, recurrence count or extra action semantics.

PLEDGE selects the most recent prerequisite proposition. A public/secret modifier shares the participant class PublicParticipants, explicitly named as wooers in C7. Until that noun is read, O is an unfilled participant slot, not an invented independent agent. Completion predicates in C2 and C5 and the endpoint in C8 all apply to C.

FIRST SECOND RESPECTIVELY OBJECT TIME1 TIME2 assigns times to the most recent asserted habitual actions of the two ordered types with that same object. The pair is C1, actions are C5 and C3, object is C, times are DAY and NIGHT. All required frames must already exist; failure to find either is an error, not permission to add an event. This clause makes no new action.

PERSON INFORM PERSON DISCOVER TIME is a serial construction: the second person is recipient of INFORM and subject of DISCOVER; the final time modifies DISCOVER only. Both predicates take the most recent concealed-action frame as content. No additional UNRAVEL is generated by either predicate.

The passage has descriptive habitual clauses and one later discovery/completion sequence. C3 and C5 describe the same prior work period; their textual order does not impose alternating executions. C7 introduces discovery of that period; THEN in C8 explicitly advances after it. No exact cycle count, no equal daily/nightly amount, no silent reset, no inferred executed marriage.

Clause boundaries are the explicit hypothesized eight spans, justified only conditionally by these construction signatures. They are not observed historical punctuation. This is a fully specified interpretive reading, not a demonstrated uniquely recoverable parser, and the rule list has not been fit or tested elsewhere.

pdalshdy.meaning: Introduce an ordered summary of two named activity types, with the explicitly written temporal/illumination qualifications and a common patient role. This is an overt nominal construction, not two executions.

shocphedy.meaning: A nominal reference to exactly the WEAVE activity type denoted by old qokeedy; no performed event.

otor.meaning: Form a temporal condition from the following daytime region or state predicate: membership in the named region, or truth of that unchanged predicate in the state at a time. The finite two-case type lifting is declared in B3.

opshedy.meaning: A nominal reference to exactly the UNRAVEL activity type denoted by old qokeey; no performed event.

otshdy.meaning: Attach the following illumination source to an activity specification.

qokedol.meaning: Torches, as an illumination source; no number of torches is assigned.

shdy.meaning: Unify the two activity specifications on the following common patient-role expression.

soldy.meaning: The as-yet unfilled artifact/patient role of this work episode; it must be filled by the first literal cloth reference, not by an invisible second artifact.

sar.meaning: Exactly the public participants O named as wooers by old qody. This is an openly added co-denoting whole form.

shedaiin.meaning: Attribute the following appearance proposition to the named experiencer; do not assert that the appearance guarantees completion.

ockhey.meaning: The apparent aspect of the following progress description.

sain.meaning: Progress on the common work patient, without a numerical amount or a completion assertion.

ched.meaning: Qualify progress as visible during the following time region.

qetal.meaning: The most recent experiencer judges the ongoing work from the explicitly marked observation period.

dal.meaning: Mark the time region used as the basis of that judgment; not a voyage, count, or physical ingredient.

shey.meaning: Negate the following epistemic condition in the current phase, not the occurrence of its action content.

lchedy.meaning: Knowledge that the second activity of the declared ordered pair occurs. This deliberately compound new value contains both KNOWLEDGE and SECOND(pair); its cost is recorded.

solkeedy.meaning: Introduce the next complete typed topic expression, an activity specification or the cloth object; the operator itself does not assert or perform the topic.

qoteedy.meaning: Illuminate the next activity specification by the same TORCHES source. This is an openly added compound expression equivalent to BY_LIGHT_OF(TORCHES).

sol.meaning: Contrast the following complete assertion with the preceding topic/assertion, without reversing the truth of either.

cheeety.meaning: Assert the habitual application of the explicitly supplied activity type to the supplied patient by the supplied worker. Its operands are patient, worker, activity type in that order.

otedy.meaning: The complement of the unchanged FINISHED(C) predicate, evaluated in the explicitly selected work phase. This is a new whole-form guess, not an o/t/e segmentation claim.

lkedy.meaning: Put the preceding unchanged state predicate inside a requirement, not an achieved state assertion.

qokchedy.meaning: Identify the explicit cloth as the patient of that requirement/request.

chckhdy.meaning: Mark the following public participant class as the requester of the stated condition.

schedair.meaning: Move the asserted action to a phase later than the earlier work period; it does not itself assert discovery.

otchedy.meaning: Under compulsion, with exactly the same modality as old okeedy; an openly added synonymous whole form.

chedain.meaning: Cap the written action with achievement of the following unchanged state predicate. This new overt endpoint construction must not alter old saii or turn every occurrence of FINISHED into an assertion.

qotedaiin.meaning: Compare the following phase-specific state with the preceding later action outcome.

otaiin.meaning: The earlier habitual work period E of this same episode, preceding the later compelled completion phase.

ldy.meaning: Type the preceding state expression as a state-of-the-cloth claim, not another action.

tchedy.meaning: Return discourse attention to the already described earlier work period; do not reverse event order or perform another action.

qotedy.meaning: The plural occurrence class of visible work progress on the cloth, with no invented count or amount.

qokal.meaning: Qualify the progress-occurrence class by the following daytime region, before its explicit cloth argument.

shecthedy.meaning: Assert strict temporal precedence of the progress occurrences over the following completion-onset event.

shecthy.meaning: The onset event of the following WHEN condition, not a second cloth or another completed weaving action.

soiiin.meaning: Refer to the most recently explicitly described plural progress-occurrence class.

checthy.meaning: Describe those occurrences as recurrent; no count is supplied.

chety.meaning: Restrict the occurrences to the following explicitly named work period.

olsaly.meaning: Distribute the recurrence over the following daytime-kind instances in that period; no number of days or equal work amounts is asserted.
